authoringRequirements.policy: Write original JLPT-style items; do not reproduce third-party protected questions, recordings or artwork without authorization.

verdicts.official-usable-with-credit: Official jlpt.jp material Reng may use with the credit line its policy asks for.
verdicts.link-only: Free material without a licence for reuse: Reng may link to it, never copy it.
verdicts.ask-permission: A licence or terms allow some reuse under conditions; the user decides before anything enters Reng.
verdicts.do-not-use: Leaked or reconstructed past papers, paid books, paywalled or all-rights-reserved sites: no reuse and no link.
